autoAssign.title: Auto-assignment
autoAssign.description: Share new conversations out among available people.
autoAssign.help: It runs when a new conversation gets its first message and no AI agent handles it, or when the AI hands it over to a person. Whoever has gone longest without an assignment goes first.
